title: BesMella.Quake Season 1
wikitext:
== Introduction ==
16 players signed up for [[BesMella.Quake Season 1]], which was also the maximum for this tourney. The tourney was planned to run for one day only, but since the brackets were up early a few of the rounds were played earlier as well. The map pool consisted of [[aerowalk]], [[ztndm3]], [[dm2]], [[dm4]] and [[dm6]], also known as [[TB5]].

* Running date: 22nd of January [[2012]]
* IRC channel: [irc://port80.se.quakenet.org/duelmania #duelmania] ([[QuakeNet]])
* Website: [http://quakeworld.tourney.cc/news/5727/season-1-over/ BesMella.Quake Season 1]

== Settings, Rules, Maps ==
* Maps allowed: [[dm2]], [[dm4]], [[dm6]], [[ztndm3]], [[aerowalk]]
* Allowed clients: [[FTEQW]] 1.00 and [[FodQuake]] 0.2 and [[ezQuake]] 2.1 or 2.1.1 with -ruleset smackdown
* Time limit: 10 minutes
* Overtime 3 minutes
* Deathmatch mode 3
* No Powerups
* No fairpacks
* Discharges enabled
* Ktpro spawns. (unless both players agree on a different mode)
* Maxfps 77.
* No berzerk, midair, instagib or other unusual modes.
* Fallbunny on.
